name: Squat
description: A lower-body compound exercise targeting quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting in a chair.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor (or as low as comfortable).
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Shoulder Flexion (Front Raise)
instructions: Stand tall with your arms resting at your sides.
Keep your arm straight but avoid locking the elbow.
Slowly raise your arm forward until it reaches shoulder height.
Hold the position briefly at the top.
Slowly lower your arm back to the starting position.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand upright with your legs together and arms at your sides.
Jump slightly into the air.
As you jump, spread your legs to be about shoulder-width apart.
Simultaneously stretch your arms out and over your head.
Jump back to the starting position.

name: Knee Extension (Standing)
instructions: Stand tall, holding onto a chair or wall for balance if needed.
Bend the knee of your exercising leg, lifting your foot slightly off the ground.
Slowly straighten your leg out in front of you.
Do not lock your knee forcefully at full extension.
Slowly return your foot to the bent starting position.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
Keep your elbow tucked close to your torso.
Bend your elbow to lift your hand towards your shoulder.
Squeeze your bicep at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your hand back to the starting position.

name: Shoulder Abduction (Side Raise)
description: Lateral deltoid and rotator-cuff rehab exercise.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms resting at your sides.
Keep your torso completely still; do not lean.
Slowly raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Keep your elbow slightly bent.
Slowly lower your arm back to your side.

name: Wall Push-Up
description: Modified push-up for upper-body strengthening; low impact.
instructions: Stand facing a wall, a little more than arm's length away.
Place your hands flat against the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to slowly lower your chest towards the wall.
Push back to the starting position.

name: Single Leg Stand
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together. Have a chair nearby for safety.
Shift your weight onto your standing leg.
Lift the foot of your other leg slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning your torso.
Hold this position for the prescribed duration, then switch if needed.

name: High Knees / Standing March
description: Dynamic hip flexor and cardiovascular exercise.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right knee as high as comfortable (aim for hip height).
Quickly switch and lift your left knee while lowering your right foot.
Keep your core engaged and torso upright.
Continue alternating legs in a marching or running motion.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: Spinal mobility exercise for lower back pain.
instructions: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Make sure your wrists are under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Cow Phase: Inhale, drop your belly towards the floor, and lift your chin and chest.
Cat Phase: Exhale, draw your belly to your spine, and round your back toward the ceiling.
Slowly alternate between the two poses.

name: Lunge (Static)
description: Lower-body unilateral strength and balance exercise.
instructions: Stand tall and take a large step forward with one leg.
Keep your upper body straight and shoulders back.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent at approximately a 90-degree angle.
Ensure your front knee is directly above your ankle, not pushed too far forward.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Bird Dog
description: Core stability and spinal control exercise.
instructions: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and left leg backward.
Keep your raised arm and leg parallel to the floor; do not arch your back.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Seated Forward Bend
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight out in front of you.
Sit up tall, keeping your spine straight.
Hinge at your hips and slowly reach your hands toward your feet.
Keep your knees straight (do not let them bend upward).
Hold the stretch for at least 1 second without bouncing, then return upright.

name: Neck Lateral Flexion
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your gaze forward and do not rotate your chin.
Slowly tilt your ear toward your shoulder until you feel a stretch.
Do not shrug or lift your shoulder to meet your ear.
Return your head to the neutral, upright position.

name: Hip Abduction (Standing)
instructions: Stand tall, holding onto a stable surface for balance.
Keep your toes pointing forward and your lifting leg straight.
Slowly lift one leg straight out to the side.
Avoid leaning your torso to the opposite side.
Slowly lower the leg back to the starting position.
